title: Sturdy Cycles Launches Two New Cnc-Machined, Uk-Made Titanium Bikes: Fosse for Road and Drove for Gravel
content:
Somerset-based titanium bicycle maker Sturdy Cycles is launching two bike models at Rouleur Live in London on 12 November: Fosse, for the road, and Drove, for gravel.

Sturdy Cycles Fosse and Drove Quick Hits

  • Prices
    • Fosse frame kit £6,000 (inc UK VAT) / £5,000 ex VAT
    • Add a SRAM Force Groupset and full build kit from £4,511.60 (inc UK VAT) / £3,759.67 ex VAT
    • Drove frame kit £6,000 (inc UK VAT) / £5,000 ex VAT
    • Add a SRAM Force groupset and full build kit £4,137.60 (inc UK VAT) / £3,448 ex VAT
    • Frame kit and build kit together make a complete bike, from £10,511.60 (Fosse) and £10,137.60 (Drove) inc UK VAT. Details and upgrade option below.
  • Headset: Enduro stainless steel, lifetime warranty – included
  • Bottom bracket: T47-68 (68mm wide T47 threaded shell)
  • Rear axle: 142×12mm; titanium thru axle included (167mm long, M12×1mm thread)
  • Derailleur hanger: UDH; titanium Sturdy edition with phosphor-bronze threads – included
  • Brake mount: Adjustable for 140mm or 160mm rotors at the frame (fork: Fosse 140mm or 160mm, Drove 160mm or 180mm)
  • Seatpost: Aero profile titanium seatpost machined in-house – included
  • Stem: Titanium, machined in-house – included
  • Fork: Fosse: ENVE IN-Route Road, 370mm design length. Drove: ENVE IN-Route Gravel, 395mm design length, with cargo mounts – included
  • Cable routing: Through the headset. Electronic groupsets only (SRAM, Shimano and Campagnolo). Wire exit points for Shimano added if required
  • Bosses:
    • Fosse: 2 bottle cage mounts in the front triangle and mudguard mounts.
    • Drove: 2 bottle cage mounts in the front triangle, a 3rd under the down tube, top tube bag mounts, and mudguard mounts
  • Tire clearance: Fosse: 35mm maximum recommended measured tire width on a 700c rim (frame 38mm, ENVE fork 35mm). Drove: 50mm (frame 55mm, ENVE fork 50mm)

Overview

The frames are built from drawn titanium tubes joined to CNC-machined titanium parts, machined, welded and finished at the workshop in Frome. Every frame kit includes an ENVE IN-Route carbon fork, a titanium seatpost and stem machined in-house, an Enduro headset, a titanium rear thru axle, a titanium UDH hanger with phosphor-bronze inserts and titanium bottle boss bolts.

The bikes showcase the latest engineering and manufacturing developments from the workshop: the 3D-printed junctions and components of earlier Sturdy frames have been replaced by fully redesigned, CNC-machined titanium parts. Every frame is designed, engineered, machined, fabricated and finished by hand at the Sturdy Cycles workshop in Frome, Somerset. The new manufacturing approach introduces a sharp, modern yet minimal aerodynamic aesthetic, ensuring every Sturdy remains a unique proposition: truly functional UK engineering refined with handmade finesse.

Both bikes come in six sizes, each in three stack heights (Low, Medium and Tall), so each model offers 18 fits. The versatile sizing is designed to streamline fabrication whilst still offering riders much of the fit of a custom frame. The Sturdy website features a new suite of interactive tools designed to help customers find their perfect fit, compare their existing bike against the new models and even design their own custom Cerakote finish.

Fosse

Fosse is a highly versatile titanium road bike. Its three stack heights let riders fine-tune the fit for speed, but its core focus is longer, endurance-friendly riding. A relatively low bottom bracket offsets the wider tires now common on road builds, keeping the bike stable at speed without losing the agility expected of a road bike. With the included ENVE IN-Route Road carbon fork, it accommodates tires up to 700×35mm.

Fosse Way: the Roman road that ran from Exeter to Lincoln, built in the first century AD. It still cuts an almost straight line across Somerset, a few miles from the Frome workshop.

Drove

Drove is a modern gravel bike for going further off the beaten track, shaped by years of designing, building and riding bikes across the wet byways, bridleways and holloways of Somerset and Wiltshire. Longer chainstays give stability at speed and sure-footed traction on steep, loose climbs; balanced front-end geometry tracks straight over rough ground. With the included ENVE IN-Route Gravel carbon fork, it takes tires up to 700×50mm, and adds a third bottle mount, top tube bag mounts and mudguard mounts.

Drove, or drovers’ roads: ancient rural routes once used to move livestock. Many are of unknown age and some date back to medieval times. These rough tracks criss-cross the Somerset and Wiltshire landscape.

Built To Last

Road grime, grit and water find their way into everything, so both frames have phosphor-bronze threads and bushes at the thru-axles and seatpost clamp, the places where titanium has a habit of seizing. Each frame kit includes an Enduro stainless steel headset with a lifetime bearing warranty, and the frames are covered by a lifetime warranty for the original owner. An interchangeable rear disc brake caliper mount swaps between 140mm and 160mm rotors without an adapter.

Finding the right fit

Sturdy’s online fitting tools help riders choose between the 18 fits. The size selector works from the position of the bike they ride now, the bar position calculator finds where their bars sit today, and compare geometry draws any two frames over each other, or over their current bike.

Finish

Every frame, stem and seatpost has a shot-peened raw titanium finish. The standard finish, included in the price, adds a down tube logo, oversize or small, in brushed titanium or one of nine Cerakote colors. Riders who want something more personal can choose a custom theme (£720 inc UK VAT / £600 ex VAT), a one or two-color Cerakote design, or a bespoke finish (from £2,400 inc UK VAT / £2,000 ex VAT). Details are agreed with each customer after ordering.

Cerakote is a highly durable ceramic-based coating, best known in the firearms industry. Its toughness and scratch resistance make it well suited to a bike that will be ridden hard all year round.

Customers can try every option on the frame in Sturdy’s online finishing selector, and see examples of past custom finishes in the past builds gallery.

Made In The UK And Available To Order Now

Each frame kit is made to order, with a lead time of about six weeks. The first frames will be dispatched in Nov/Dec 2026. Once a customer has placed an order, Tom and Jack begin the manufacturing process, and the customer confirms their fit and finish details through a personal build page.

The Frome workshop uses CNC machining to make and finish the frame’s machined titanium parts, combined with manual machining and traditional hand tools to ensure every frame meets Sturdy’s standards. All Sturdy Cycles frames are prepared, welded, and finished by hand under one roof. The workshop hosts a range of professional finishing equipment, including parts tumbling, polishing, glass bead blasting and wet spray painting using Cerakote ceramic coatings. Sturdy Cycles is proud to be one of the only UK titanium bicycle manufacturers physically manufacturing, finishing, and assembling everything it produces in-house. Workshop visits can be arranged for customers and press, and international shipping is available.

Coming in 2027

A Sturdy titanium fork for each model is due in 2027, raising tire clearance to 38mm on Fosse and 55mm on Drove.

Find out all the details and more at Sturdy Cycles.
